parameters.toolDescription: Summarizes provided conversation text (last lines, truncated). Pass concatenated dialogue as query.
parameters.code: const text=String(query||''); if(!text) return 'No input'; const lines=text.split(/\n/); const last=lines.slice(-40); let joined=last.join('\n'); if(joined.length>800) joined=joined.slice(joined.length-800); return 'Summary:'+joined;

const q=String(query||'').toLowerCase(); if(/schema|field|odometer/.test(q)) return 'schema'; if(/test|unit|spec/.test(q)) return 'test'; if(/explain|help|describe/.test(q)) return 'explain'; if(/diff|patch|refactor|clean/.test(q)) return 'refactor'; return 'general';

const secretRe=/sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}/; return items.map(i=>{ const data=i.json.data; let text=typeof data==='string'?data:JSON.stringify(data); if(secretRe.test(text)){ i.json.redacted=true; i.json.data='[REDACTED: secret-like pattern removed]'; } return i; });

const store=getWorkflowStaticData('global'); store.tokens=store.tokens||0; return items.map(i=>{ const content=JSON.stringify(i.json.data||''); const est=Math.ceil(content.length/4); store.tokens+=est; i.json.tokenEstimate=est; i.json.totalTokens=store.tokens; if(store.tokens>80000){ i.json.warning='token budget exceeded'; } return i; });
